body: As I tune in, the distorted sound of an unfamiliar melody washes over me like cold water. Panic starts clawing at my mind. "No!" I shout mentally, trying to convince myself it’s just background noise. My heart pounds against my chest as I frantically search for any escape route, imagining chaos if someone from outside hears the intrusion.
